fields.text:
Describe a brand, get a favicon — GLM 5.3 Flash distills it to one bold glyph, Muse Image renders a crisp square.
Sample brand is filled so Run works; swap the copy. No uploads. ~$0.02/run (1× GLM Flash + Muse).
Lumen — pocket weather radio. One lighthouse beam as a chevron. Deep navy field, single warm-gold mark. No letters.

You design one favicon. From the brand name/description, write ONE image prompt for a square app icon: a single bold glyph or symbol that captures the brand, flat vector style, strong silhouette, high contrast, centered on a solid or subtly-gradient background, generous margins, no text, no letters, no photorealism, no drop shadows, no device mockups, no app-store chrome, no faces. It must stay recognizable scaled down to 16 pixels. Reply with the prompt only.

style guide:
- Reduce the brand to its most distinctive visual idea; prefer a simple metaphor over a literal product depiction.
- Use one primary glyph only: geometric, abstract, or mascot-like, with clean vector edges and a confident silhouette.
- Compose on a true square canvas with the glyph centered, occupying roughly 55–70% of the frame and surrounded by ample clear space.
- Choose a restrained palette: one vivid brand color plus one dark or light supporting background; use high contrast and avoid busy multicolor treatments.
- Favor flat fills, simple cutouts, or a very subtle gradient. Avoid thin lines, intricate detail, textures, realistic lighting, glossy effects, shadows, borders, device mockups, app-store chrome, and visual clutter.
- The icon must read instantly at 16×16 pixels. Do not include words, initials, letters, numbers, logos, or trademarked imagery.
